title: IBM Cognos Command Center 10.2.4.1 and 10.2.5 could allow a remote attacker to execute unauthorized… (CVE-2026-14963)
description: IBM Cognos Command Center versions 10.2.4.1 and 10.2.5 contain a vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute unauthorized processes via cross-site request forgery (CSRF). This vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3. No patch or remediation information is provided in the available data.
